scope: October 13, 2025 Law; common rules; Marquise, Eyrie, Alliance, one Vagabond; Fall/Winter; Thief/Tinker/Ranger; dominance/coalitions. Excludes expansion systems, second Vagabond, hirelings, landmarks, bots and Advanced Setup.

independence.source_read: Complete applicable passages in extracted text, cross-checked against corresponding authoritative PDF text, pages 1-10, C.1 on 24, G on 25-26, M.1-2 on 27 and V.1-3 on 28. Excluded passages sharing pages were not used as rule authority.

findings.finding: All 79 questions have matching unique key IDs. Seventy-eight expected answers are sufficiently complete and source-supported; Q37 is source-supported but incomplete for its unqualified production request, which also includes Overwork.

Passes 12/13 overlook the Strike action cost. Q19 expressly asks what Strike targets, while its key supplies the unrequested crossbow cost. Neither the other individual action questions nor Q79 asks which item pays Strike. The one-crossbow payment is a new core action-cost rule, not a different number or recombination of an already-tested Strike cost.

The shorthand "forced non-bird give/discard must include birds" should be read as must treat bird cards as the prompted suit. It does not impose bird-first selection or require extra cards. The answer is substantively supported under that reading; optional precision edit is not a new question or required key correction.
findings.suggested_wording: For forced non-bird give/discard effects, you must treat bird cards as the prompted suit.

findings.finding: Other applicable procedures map to actual question requests as documented in checked_passages. Overwork production is requested by Q37 but ungraded in its fixed v5 key; its coverage is conditional on the required Q37 key correction, not credited as complete in v5.

Q37 asks when and how much wood the Marquise produces without restricting that request to routine Birdsong production. Overwork is another source-backed production method: during Daylight an Overwork action spends a card matching a sawmill clearing and places one wood there. The fixed v5 expected answer and references include only Birdsong production. The Overwork output must be added to the key before that branch can count as tested; a separate output question is not necessary.

proposed_questions.question: What item and how many of it must the Vagabond exhaust to take the Daylight Strike action, and can an exhausted or damaged copy pay that cost?
proposed_questions.expected_answer: Exhaust one face-up, undamaged crossbow. An already exhausted or damaged crossbow cannot pay the action cost.

source_support.text: Strike. Exhaust one C to remove an enemy warrior from your clearing.
The Vagabond exhausts face-up undamaged items, flipping them face down, to take many actions.

proposed_questions.novelty: The genuinely new rule is which item and quantity pays Strike: one crossbow. Ready/undamaged eligibility repeats Q50 only as contextual precision and is not counted as novelty. Q19 requests Strike target priority, not cost; a reader could answer every requested Q19 part correctly while wrongly believing Strike costs a boot or no item. Q75 separately tests the sword cost of Battle and cannot establish the crossbow cost of this other action. This is a first test of a rule-defined action cost, not a numeric variant of an already-tested Strike payment.

stopping_assessment.basis: The v5 actual request/key pair must be complete: add a new Strike-cost question and correct Q37 key in a new version. required_key_corrections.question_interpretation: Unqualified when/how much wood production includes both Birdsong sawmill placement and optional Daylight Overwork. No phase limitation appears in the question.
required_key_corrections.current_expected_answer: Birdsong one wood per sawmill in its clearing, finite eight wood supply. Evening one card plus uncovered draw bonuses, discard to five.
required_key_corrections.replacement_expected_answer: During Birdsong, place one wood per sawmill in that sawmill's clearing. During Daylight, an optional Overwork action spends a card matching a clearing with a sawmill to place one wood token in that clearing. Production is limited by the finite eight-wood supply; place the maximum available when unable to place all required pieces, and costs are not waived. In Evening, draw one card plus uncovered draw bonuses, then discard chosen hand cards down to five.

source_support.text: Overwork. Spend a card matching the clearing of a sawmill to place a wood token there.

required_key_corrections.versioning_requirement: Apply to a newly versioned answer key/benchmark; do not silently expand grading of already-fixed benchmark-v5 responses. This review does not mutate either input.
